title: 第158章 Be a River
slug: 电竞世界冠军选秀c位出道
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“在公布第八名之前，我们将揭晓本次顺位排名在第二十名的练习生。”

俞岚话音落下，充满悬念感的BGM响起。

嘟嘟嘟的鼓点重锤在每个处于淘汰边缘的选手心头，每一拍都引起震颤。

【怎么都有钱了，这雷霆BGM还是没有换？】

【难道是我们误会了，根本不是没钱才选这个，是因为洪留的审美就是这个？】

【其他不知道，洪留审美确实挺雷霆的。】

“第二十名——董法！”

镜头停留在眼眶微微泛红的董法身上。

镜头里的人一愣，随即爆发出一个巨大的笑容，在身边人的恭喜下乐呵呵走向感言区。

陈越在心心念念的决赛前被淘汰了，他看着金字塔座席上满脸喜气的晋级区选手，又扫了一眼正专注看着感言区的江执屿，面无表情。

镜头也始终不曾在他附近停留，一如既往。

顺位公布继续推进，很快来到前八名。

“第八名，邓苏水，6854223票。”

【？？？？啊？】

【我去邓苏水掉第八了？？】

【果然是OnepiCk来了就知道谁在裸泳。】

【为什么这么惊讶，其实可以预见啊，他之前人气就一直在下滑。】

【邓苏水掉归掉，也没像某人一样掉出出道位啊。】

“第七名，喻文，7437675票。”

“第六名，安俊英，8912331票。”

“第五名，姚为，10052767票。”

姚为愣了一下，随即咧嘴笑起来，快步起身。

他的排名一直在稳步上升，这对出身小公司没什么宣发经费的他来说也是一件很不可思议的事情。

【我去，第五名就已经上千万票了吗？？我怎么记得二公江执屿才破千万？这是什么恐怖流量票池。】

【好感慨，还记得选座那时候像小狗一样围着江执屿打转的样子，现在也是拥有很多粉丝的成熟偶像了。】

【等等，没记错的话这小子偶像是River？是不是早就认出来了没跟家人们分享这个秘密？好小子！】

【真好啊，姚为和江执屿一起出道吧！！】

Page (1/3)

"Before announcing the eighth place, we will announce the trainee ranked 20th this time."

After Yu Lan finished speaking, a suspenseful BGM sounded.

The heavy beat of the drum beats in the hearts of every contestant who is on the verge of elimination, causing tremors with every beat.

[How come you have money, but the Thunder BGM still hasn’t been changed?】

[Could it be that we misunderstood? We didn’t choose this because we had no money at all, but because this is Hong Liu’s aesthetic?】

[I don’t know anything else, but Hong Liu’s aesthetics are indeed quite impressive.】

“Twentieth place—Dong Fa!”

The camera stayed on Dong Fa, whose eyes were slightly red.

The person in the camera was stunned for a moment, then broke out into a huge smile, and happily walked to the speech area under the congratulations of the people around him.

Chen Yue was eliminated before the finals that he had been thinking about. He looked at the happy-faced contestants in the promotion area in the pyramid seats, and then glanced at Jiang Zhiyu, who was looking at the speech area with an expressionless face.

The camera never stopped near him, as always.

The announcement of the picks continued, and the top eight were soon reached.

"Eighth place, Deng Sushui, 6854223 votes."

【????ah?】

[I went to Deng Su Water and finished eighth??】

[As expected, OnepiCk knows who is swimming naked when he comes.】

[Why are you so surprised? It was actually foreseeable. His popularity has been declining before.】

[Deng Sushui returned, but he didn’t fall out of the Taoist position like someone else.】

"Seventh place, Yu Wen, 7437675 votes."

"Sixth place, Ahn Joon Young, 8,912,331 votes."

"Fifth place, Yao Wei, 10052767 votes."

Yao Wei was stunned for a moment, then grinned and stood up quickly.

His ranking has been rising steadily, which is incredible for him who comes from a small company with little publicity funds.

[Let me go, does fifth place already have tens of millions of votes??Why do I remember that Ergong Jiang Zhiyu only exceeded 10 million?What a terrifying traffic ticket pool this is.】

[It’s so emotional. I still remember how I was circling Jiang Zhiyu like a puppy when I was choosing seats. Now I am a mature idol with many fans.】

[Wait, if I remember correctly, this boy’s idol is River?Did he recognize it a long time ago and not share this secret with his family?Good boy!】

[That’s great, let’s make Yao Wei and Jiang Zhiyu debut together!!】
